name: Vendor maintenance vs. payment release
description: The same person could create a fictitious vendor and pay it.

name: Purchase request vs. purchase approval
description: The same person could request and approve their own purchase.

name: Journal entry creation vs. approval
description: The same person could post and approve an accounting entry.

name: Payroll maintenance vs. payroll approval
description: The same person could change pay data and approve the payroll run.

name: Bank reconciliation vs. payment release
description: The same person could release a payment and hide it in the reconciliation.

name: User administration vs. audit log administration
description: The same person could grant access and erase the trail of that change.

name: Code development vs. production deploy
description: The same person could write code and push it to production unreviewed.

name: Inventory adjustment vs. inventory count approval
description: The same person could adjust stock and approve the count.

name: Invoice entry vs. payment release
description: The same person could enter an invoice and release its payment.
